name: Taiwan Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Co., Ltd. (TSC) functions as a global producer and vendor, offering a wide range of discrete semiconductor devices and power integrated circuits. The company structures its operations around two primary divisions: Rectifier and Bar Code Printer. Its extensive selection of discrete components includes items such as bridge rectifiers, various types of diodes, DIACs, thyristors, ESD protection solutions, MOSFETs, and transistors. Alongside these, its power IC lineup features amplifiers, comparators, an assortment of analog ICs, both linear and switching voltage regulators, voltage references, Hall effect sensors, and lighting ICs. These specialized products are crucial for a diverse array of electronic applications, spanning sectors like automotive, computing, consumer electronics, industrial machinery, telecommunications, and photovoltaic systems. Founded in 1968, TSC is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
